messages:
tessa: opened a tiny PR to add 'provisioning guardrails' examples (YAML + short SDK snippets) for Dedicated onboarding. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/456
mike: include both YAML + 2-line SDK examples. users copy YAML straight into infra.
olivia: agree. please avoid using 'preemption' alone  clarify reserved-pool semantics as 'best-effort eviction' vs 'forced eviction'.
sre-ryan: ops note: add a line about graceful SLO degradation and notifications: 'under sustained capacity pressure latency SLOs may degrade; fallback policies are applied and customers are notified (console + webhook)'. also recommend cooldown + min_replicas to avoid thrash.
nora: i'll follow up with a short migration checklist (shared -> dedicated) and link it from the handbook.
docs-bot: Reminder: add a changelog entry (docs/CHANGELOG.md).
tessa: thanks — i'll align SDK param names to v0.8, add a one-line isolation-label definition, include the YAML + Python + tiny Go snippet, add the ops wording and changelog, then ping for review.
